description: Runs the Studio app from a pull request (or any ref) in dev mode with its own app data (DEV_CONFIG_DIR=/tmp/studio-test), so the user's Studio sites are untouched: `homeboy rig up studio-pr --ref studio=<PR URL>`. The ref is checked out as a detached worktree of the registered `studio` component (or HOMEBOY_RIG_COMPONENT_PATH__STUDIO_PR__STUDIO).

cleanup.reason: pipeline.down stops the dev app; the checkout, its node_modules and /tmp/studio-test app data stay.

check.label: Node's major version matches the checkout's .nvmrc
check.command: want=$(cut -d. -f1 .nvmrc); have=$(node --version | cut -d. -f1 | tr -d v); [ "$want" = "$have" ] || { echo "Studio wants Node $(cat .nvmrc); this shell has $(node --version). Run nvm use in the checkout."; exit 1; }

up.label: Install dependencies when the lockfile changed
up.command: lock=$(shasum package-lock.json); [ "$(cat node_modules/.homeboy-installed-lock 2>/dev/null)" = "$lock" ] || { npm ci --no-audit --no-fund && echo "$lock" > node_modules/.homeboy-installed-lock; }
